verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Attio supports workspace-installable apps: apps 'install' into a workspace, appear in an Apps sidebar section, and expose admin settings pages. However, all of it describes developers building their own apps with the App SDK, not an ops user picking prebuilt integrations from a marketplace. Missing for 10: any documented app marketplace or directory, named prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing tools, data warehouse), a no-code install flow for ops users, and independent corroboration.
